summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, rights-dependent affiliate or advertising use, and external outreach. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; continue only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize the data are not established; all four legal tasks remain open; accuracy, freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Technical compliance is a baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. No unsupported telemetry, revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal claims are approved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and all 4 remain open. searchwoot-legal-source-rights: blocked pending current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. searchwoot-data-flow-retention: evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence: evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident: evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. No task is closable on current evidence.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data: counsel_required. Missing written permission or API agreement, field-level rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet triage: ordinary reversible growth is conditional only on site-specific evidence and preservation of existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Incomplete analytics does not alone block ordinary growth; do not infer zero traffic, revenue, conversion, or performance. Data quality is yellow for analytics permissions or collector errors, and revenue evidence is limited to one period with $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Keep all public, rights-dependent, regulated, age-sensitive, and monetization-expansion launches blocked or evidence_needed until site-specific checklists support a decision.

Private and gated-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Both are scaffolds with analytics unconfigured and unreachable compliance evidence; no public launch or monetization decision is supported. Next evidence action for each is one timestamped read-only checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent/cookies, privacy, terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns, followed by exactly one retain-parked or bounded-launch recommendation.
